technique_name: In 100 words or less, tell a story about the consequences of the choices people make
description: People’s lives can take an unexpected twist and turn due to the choices they make. Take John, for example. He was an engineering student with no interest in partying. But one night he decided to join his friends on a night of revelry, and ended up risking his friendship with his best friend when he cheated on Rachel with the new girl at school.
